title: Prime Minister congratulates Jehan Dorab Madan and Shubham Wadhwa on winning Bronze at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Jehan Dorab Madan and Shubham Wadhwa for winning Bronze in Men’s Doubles Class MD4 at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that their achievement marks India’s first-ever medal in this event at the Games, extending his best wishes to both for many more successes ahead. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Congratulations to Jehan Dorab Madan and Shubham Wadhwa on winning Bronze in Men’s Doubles Class MD4 at the Asian Para Games! Their achievement marks India’s first-ever medal in this event at the Games. Best wishes to both for many more successes ahead: PM @narendramodi" Congratulations to Jehan Dorab Madan and Shubham Wadhwa on winning Bronze in Men’s Doubles Class MD4 at the Asian Para Games!
